import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for survived vs pclass, colored by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='Set2', dodge=True)

# Adding titles and labels

plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=14)

plt.close()

import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn

# Create a count plot for survived vs pclass, colored by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='Set2', dodge=True)

plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2], labels=['Third Class', 'First Class', 'Second Class'], fontsize=12)
